subject: Sandbox validation sprint and success metrics - Landmark.ai
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@landmark.ai>, Maya Fernandes <maya@landmark.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed sandbox validation sprint

Thanks for the conversation today — quick recap and a concrete proposal so we can get the sandbox running next week. High level: we recommend a 3-week sandbox validation sprint focused on your two primary success metrics (latency under 220ms at 95th pct for inference, and semantic fidelity on your returns dataset > 0.86 F1).

Proposed plan (draft):
- Kickoff: 2/18 or 2/19 (45–60m) — introductions, access checklist, confirm acceptance tests
- Week 1 (env + baseline): environment provisioned, model variants deployed, baseline runs
- Week 2 (workload tuning): batching/quantization experiments, KV prefix caching, cost estimates
- Week 3 (readout + handoff): final run, metrics readout, recommended config for prod

Owners:
- Redwood infra & env setup: Grace O'Connor (SE)
- Customer success & acceptance: Monica Patel (CS)
- Sales lead / commercial: Aditya Rao (me)

Immediate asks for your team so we can scope properly:
1) Which cloud account (AWS account ID) should we use for the sandbox, or do you want Redwood-hosted ephemeral env?
2) Who on your side will own network/SSO/ingress (name + email)?
3) Sample of representative requests (anonymized) or the 2–3 canonical prompt flows you'd like us to validate (attachments: Landmark-success-metrics.xlsx has suggested acceptance tests).

Attachments: Landmark-success-metrics.xlsx (acceptance test template), redwood-eval-eng-setup.pdf (how we configure the sandbox).

Next step: if 2/18 works, Grace will provision the env on 2/17 and we’ll send a calendar invite tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward.

– Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: Landmark-success-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet) ]
[Attachment: redwood-eval-eng-setup.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@landmark.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Maya Fernandes <maya@landmark.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed sandbox validation sprint

Thanks Aditya — that reads well. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates:
- We prefer Redwood-hosted ephemeral env for speed, but we need SSO (SAML) integrated so our engineers can access logs.
- We can provide anonymized request traces; I’ll share an export.
- Can Redwood pre-configure a 7B quantized model and an FP16 baseline for comparison?

2/18 is better for us (we have stakeholders out on 2/17). If Grace can provision on 2/17 for a 2/18 kickoff, that works.

Also adding Rajiv Kumar (rajiv@landmark.ai) on infra — he’ll handle account/SSO details.

Cheers,
Jason
CTO, Landmark.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed sandbox validation sprint (internal)

Internal note — I’ll take env ownership. Short checklist I’ll run through:
- Provision ephemeral cluster on Redwood account (if customer OK) or stand up in their AWS (prefer RBAC via cross-account role)
- SAML SSO integration (need metadata from Rajiv)
- Preload sample prompts & anonymized traces (Jason said he will export)
- Deploy two model stacks: 7B quantized (recommended) + FP16 baseline
- Set up metrics dashboard (latency P95, tokens-per-second, failure rate, cost per 1k tokens) and the acceptance tests from Landmark-success-metrics.xlsx

Targets & timeline:
- 2/17: environment provisioned + basic smoke tests (Grace)
- 2/18 kickoff 10:00–10:45 PT (confirm)
- 2/24: mid-sprint review (Monica to run acceptance tests with Landmark)
- 3/3: final readout prep

Attaching my env checklist (landmark-env-checklist.docx) and a short note on required IAM roles. Monica — will you lead the mid-sprint acceptance run with their product owners?

Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

[Attachment: landmark-env-checklist.docx (Word)]

- Rajiv will send SAML metadata and an AWS account role if needed (cc’d).
- We’ll upload a 48-hour sample of request traces to the secure file share by EOD 2/16.
- We prefer Redwood-hosted ephemeral env for speed; please send terms for a short sandbox agreement (DocuSign or HubSpot link).
